{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Guardian Hull Reinforcement Package''' is an optional internal module derived from [[Guardian]] technology. Each package adds a fixed amount of hull integrity and applies '''2% thermal resistance''' and '''5% caustic resistance''' to the ship's hull. It does not add kinetic or explosive resistance.<ref name="module-data">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/c228adb6c0425fc2c3a606be96114ed7a369f27a/modules/internal/guardian_hull_reinforcement_package.json EDCD Coriolis Data: Guardian Hull Reinforcement Package records], commit pinned; accessed 15 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Guardian_Hull_Reinforcement_Package Elite Dangerous Wiki: Guardian Hull Reinforcement Package], accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>

Unlike an ordinary [[Hull Reinforcement Package]], the Guardian module draws power. It is available in Classes 1–5 with E- and D-rated versions. D-rated packages are lighter and provide more hull integrity, while E-rated packages draw slightly less power and cost less.

The two maintained community datasets used here disagree by 2 Cr on each Class 5 reference value; the table follows the current Elite Dangerous Wiki values. This minor discrepancy does not affect module performance.<ref name="module-data" /><ref name="edwiki" />

== Hull resistance behavior ==

The flat integrity from every fitted package is added to the ship's hull pool. The resistance bonuses apply to the resulting hull rather than only to the points supplied by that one module. Multiple resistance sources combine through the normal hull-resistance calculation rather than by simple addition.

The package's 5% caustic resistance distinguishes it from a standard Hull Reinforcement Package. Ordinary packages can supply more raw integrity after substantial [[Engineering]], do not draw power, and can be modified for human damage types. The Guardian package instead provides its caustic and thermal resistance in its stock form. Which trade-off suits a ship is an outfitting decision rather than an inherent upgrade from one family to the other.

== Unlock and acquisition ==

The module requires one permanent unlock at a '''Guardian Technology Broker'''. The recorded unlock cost is:<ref name="edwiki" />

* 1 Guardian Module Blueprint Fragment
* 21 Guardian Sentinel Wreckage Components
* 16 Pattern Beta Obelisk Data
* 16 Pattern Gamma Obelisk Data
* 12 Reinforced Mounting Plates

After the unlock, additional packages are purchased for credits through outfitting where stocked; the materials are not paid again for every ordinary copy. Broker locations and station stock are dynamic.<ref>[https://inara.cz/elite/techbroker/ INARA: Technology Broker unlocks], accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>

== Engineering ==

Guardian Hull Reinforcement Packages do not accept the ordinary Heavy Duty, Lightweight, Blast Resistant, Kinetic Resistant, or Thermal Resistant Hull Reinforcement blueprints, nor the associated Experimental Effects.

In Live, Frontier states that '''Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance''' can be applied to all Guardian modules without a performance penalty. The change protects Guardian technology from anti-Guardian fields; it does not alter the package's listed hull-integrity or resistance values.<ref>[https://www.elitedangerous.com/update-notes/4-0-18-07 Frontier Developments: Elite Dangerous 18.07 Update Notes], accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>
